quests.title: Know the Wheel
quests.description: Deathguard Halloran has watched a hundred newly-arrived dead wander into the Canal because they could not tell the quarters from one another. Walk the four great halls - Royal, Magic, War and Apothecarium - and learn the wheel before it learns you.
quests.accept_text: Four quarters, one wheel. Royal to the north-west, Magic north-east, War south-west, Apothecarium south-east. Walk them all.
quests.turn_in_text: You came back and you are not green. The Undercity has a use for you yet.

quests.accept_text: Along the north promenade, west of the elevator. The Executor will want it in her hand.
quests.turn_in_text: Halloran. Of course. Never a word wasted. Here, take something for your troubles.

quests.accept_text: The Scarlet Watch Post, east of Brill. Zealots and bowmen. Leave none in sight of the road.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. The portal stays dark and the Crusade stays outside. Quarter-master's thanks, from me.

quests.turn_in_text: A very tidy hand. They are afraid of us, and have been told to hide it. I find that touching.

quests.accept_text: Tin ore from the western hills if you've no stock. The forge is south-west of the War Hall. Light it, and smelt three bars.

quests.turn_in_text: A ward of twelve strokes, carved by a mason who couldn't count. Delightful. Thank you.

quests.title: A Scroll for Raven Hill
quests.description: Loremaster Sennarath has tracked the Cult's cipher across half of Lordaeron, and now believes Keeper Oswin at Raven Hill Cemetery has the missing key. The scroll is sealed in grave-wax and she is not letting it leave the Undercity except in a pair of steady hands.

objectives.label: Take the scroll to Keeper Oswin, Raven Hill Cemetery, Silverpine North

quests.accept_text: North, by portal, into Silverpine. Raven Hill Cemetery. Oswin knows the cipher. Put it in his hand. Do not read it.
quests.turn_in_text: He frowns the way I do. A good sign. Give me a moment - there will be a reply.

on_accept.name: Sennarath's Sealed Scroll
on_accept.description: Grave-wax over parchment. It smells of old libraries.

objectives.label: Return Oswin's reply to Loremaster Sennarath in the Undercity

quests.accept_text: Back to the Undercity and Sennarath. Keep it dry. Keep it close. Keep your opinions to yourself.
quests.turn_in_text: 'Yes, the key is in the husks.' Of course it is. Oswin always did like his answers buried.

on_accept.name: Oswin's Reply
on_accept.description: Two lines in a cramped hand. The ink is still damp.

quests.accept_text: The Queen is in the Royal Quarter's great hall. Stand before her. Bow, if the knees allow it.
quests.turn_in_text: She has been told. She says: 'Remember the face.' I would take that as the highest praise she gives.

quests.turn_in_text: You heard it too, then. Good. Come back when you are much stronger. There is work below.

quests.accept_text: Through the iron door, then down. The Outer Cistern. Bring friends. The Society's work is not for lone travellers.

quests.turn_in_text: Six. Green-grey. Warm. Not natural, not remotely. Someone is feeding this on purpose. Thank you.

quests.accept_text: The Court of Rot, north-west wing. The Blighted Courtiers. Four ledgers, any condition. I can read through a stain.

quests.title: The Infected Noble
quests.description: The Faulkner line was Lordaeron nobility. The last Faulkner was murdered in his bed, raised in a vat, and given a signet he does not remember. The Society dressed him as a figurehead for the coup. Wrenfall wants the figurehead removed and the signet recovered.
quests.accept_text: Throne of Rot, the Plague Depths' west wing. Kill him. Take the signet off the body. Do not wear it.
quests.turn_in_text: A dead man's ring on a dead man's finger. Good. It goes in the vault, and the vault stays shut.

quests.description: Surgeon Halvard needs to see what the Society has been growing in the Vault of Flesh. The failed experiments carry fistfuls of tissue still working out what they were supposed to be. Five samples will tell him how long the vats have been running.
quests.accept_text: The Vault of Flesh, east wing. Failed Experiments. Gloves on. Don't think about the faces.
quests.turn_in_text: Five. Fresh, grey and still trying. The vats have been running longer than anyone told me.

quests.title: What the Vats Grew
quests.description: The tissue samples point to a single source: a creature at the heart of the Vault of Flesh, still growing. Halvard calls it the Vile Plague Abomination. It does not recognise anything as a friend.
quests.accept_text: The Vault of Flesh, deepest chamber. It is large, loud and wet. Bring a healer.

quests.title: The Heart of the Plague
quests.description: Vex, the Noble, Voss and the Abomination were the Society's four limbs. Zul'keth is the heart, a Dark Sorcerer who believes the Dark Lady has failed, and who has built a pulsing furnace of plague under the city to prove it. End him, and the Society's coup ends with him.
quests.accept_text: The Plague Heart, the deepest room. Everything you've killed so far was his. Finish it.
quests.turn_in_text: It beats no more. The Society is leaderless and the Dark Lady is still on her throne. Take her gratitude, and mine.

quests.title: The Dark Lady's Gratitude
quests.description: Master Apothecary Sable has written the whole sorry tale of the Society's coup into a sealed report. It needs to reach the Queen herself - not by messenger, not by raven, but by the hand that finished it.

objectives.label: Take Sable's report to Lady Sylvanas

quests.accept_text: The Royal Quarter's great hall. Hand it to her. Do not say anything clever.
quests.turn_in_text: She reads it, slowly. She says nothing. Then she says: 'The Forsaken do not forget.' That is as close to thanks as the Dark Lady gets.

quests.title: A Writ for the Frontier
quests.description: The Undercity signs writs and the frontier receives them, usually late and usually about something the frontier has already dealt with. This one is different: it is a standing authority for the commander at Tarren Mill to act in the valley without referring north, and the Executor has had it sitting on his desk for a month because signing it means admitting he cannot run Hillsbrad from here.

objectives.label: Deliver the writ to Commander Vellis Thorne in Tarren Mill

quests.accept_text:
South. Through Silverpine, down into Hillsbrad, east to a mill town cut in half by a water channel. Thorne holds it.

The writ gives her authority I would rather keep. I am sending it anyway, because the alternative is losing the valley by post.
quests.turn_in_text:
He signed it.

I have been asking for this for two years and I had stopped expecting it. Do you know what this is? It is permission to stop waiting.

There is Alterac money in these hills, there are wizards in a scrap camp, and there is a man in Durnholde keeping a court. I can go after all three now without writing north first.
